contentRules.name: readme-renders-off-github
contentRules.message: README.md is also the @stdd/cli package page, and npm renders it through GitHub's Markdown API in `markdown` mode: mermaid becomes raw source, `> [!NOTE]` a literal blockquote, `<video>` is stripped, and task lists lose their checkboxes. Use an SVG referenced by a relative path, which renders identically on both surfaces.

contentRules.name: readme-keeps-its-proof
contentRules.message: README.md must embed docs/assets/doctor.svg. Without it the freshness tests in test/readme-proof.test.mjs still pass while the proof they exist to protect is gone from the page.

contentRules.name: readme-keeps-the-loop-diagram
contentRules.message: README.md must embed docs/assets/loop.svg. It is the only place the page explains what each command in the loop is for; test/readme-proof.test.mjs keeps the asset current but cannot notice it leaving the page.

contentRules.name: readme-keeps-the-levels-diagram
contentRules.message: README.md must embed docs/assets/levels.svg. Without it the page states the three adoption levels nowhere, and a reader has to infer from the install commands which of them changes their repository.

contentRules.name: readme-commands-are-copyable
contentRules.message: A command in README.md carries an unresolved <placeholder>, which sends the reader away to find a value in the one place where friction costs the most. Use a real value.
